title: 地 (de) in Chinese: HSK 2 Grammar with Examples
description: How to use 地 (de) in Chinese to say how someone does something: the word order, 慢慢地 and 好好地, 的 vs 地 vs 得, and HSK 2 example sentences.
h1: How to Use 地 (de) to Say How Something Is Done
lede: 地 (de) turns a word like 高兴 (happy) into something like "happily". It goes between the description and the verb, so it tells you how someone does something. It is an HSK 2 grammar point and one of the three particles pronounced de.

paras: The description comes before the verb, not after it as in English: "he said happily" is 他高兴地说, literally "he happy 地 said". 地 is pronounced with a light, neutral tone. If the description is negative, 不 stays inside it: 不高兴地 means "unhappily".

examples.py: Tā gāoxìng de shuō: “Wǒ míngtiān lái!”
Tā bù gāoxìng de zǒu le.

sections.h2: Doubled words: 慢慢地, 好好地
paras: A one-syllable adjective is often doubled before 地: 慢慢地 (slowly), 好好地 (properly, well), 早早地 (nice and early). Doubling makes the description sound more vivid.
With doubled words, 地 can usually be left out. 你慢慢吃 and 你慢慢地吃 are both correct.

examples.en: She got up nice and early.

paras: A single one-syllable adjective does not normally take 地. Put it straight before the verb (快走, 慢走), or add 很 and then use 地: 很快地. 快地 on its own sounds wrong.
地 also follows counting phrases such as 一个一个地 (one by one) and 一个字一个字地 (one character at a time).

examples.py: Tā hěn kuài de chīwán le fàn.

examples.zh: 请大家一个一个地进来。
examples.py: Qǐng dàjiā yí ge yí ge de jìnlái.
examples.en: Please come in one by one, everyone.

examples.py: Tā yí ge zì yí ge zì de xiě.
examples.en: He writes one character at a time.

paras: All three are pronounced de, so learners mix them up in writing. 的 comes before a noun (快乐的孩子, a happy child). 地 comes before a verb (快乐地笑, laugh happily). 得 comes after a verb and adds a comment on how the action is done (跑得很快, runs fast).
A simple test: look at the word straight after the gap. If it is a noun, write 的; if it is a verb, write 地. If the gap comes right after the verb, write 得.

examples.py: Tā shì yí ge kuàilè de háizi.

paras: The most common mistake is writing 的 instead of 地: 她高兴的说 should be 她高兴地说. You will see 的 used this way in casual writing online, but in textbooks and in the HSK exam the verb needs 地.
The other mistake is putting the description after the verb, as in English. 孩子们唱歌快乐地 is wrong; say 孩子们快乐地唱歌. The description with 地 always comes before the verb.

worksheet.title: 地 (de) Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 地 (de) worksheet for HSK 2: 20 exercises (choose 的, 地 or 得, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 的, 地 or 得
exercises.instructions: Write 的, 地 or 得 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: This is a very good question.
The food my mum cooks is delicious.

items.zh: 他们非常快乐＿＿玩了一天。
items.en: They played very happily all day.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence with 地.

answers: 我们要好好地学习汉语。

items.en: Day by day, the children grew up.
answers: 孩子们一天一天地长大了。

items.en: He sat comfortably in the chair watching TV.
answers: 他舒服地坐在椅子上看电视。
他坐在椅子上舒服地看电视。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 这是一个很快乐地孩子。
items.en: This is a very happy child.
answers: 这是一个很快乐的孩子。
